calibration.activation_statistic: llama.cpp quantized GPU model input-channel sum of squares; 65536 occurrences per recorded tensor

development_screen.metric: mean target negative log likelihood in nats per token, plus first-token agreement and greedy common-prefix length

Q4G64V0.axis: 64 consecutive K values within each N row
Q4G64V0.scale: FP16 per group; smallest finite normal-or-larger value >= max(abs(weight))/7

Q8G32V0.axis: 32 consecutive K values within each N row
Q8G32V0.scale: FP16 per group; smallest finite normal-or-larger value >= max(abs(weight))/127

physical_layout.BF16: existing row-major, vector, convolution or cuda_bf16_dense_tile_v0 by family
physical_layout.dense_tile: 8 output rows by 256 input coordinates; separate scale array
physical_layout.padding: pad N to 8 and K to 256 for quantized dense tiles; emit zero codes and scales for padded coordinates; exclude padding from outputs and statistics

proposed_dispatch.decode: one-view grouped Q4/Q8 GPU row decoder; BF16 small-family kernels
proposed_dispatch.prefill: decode bounded grouped Q4/Q8 tiles to BF16 staging for tensor-core contraction; BF16 small-family kernels
proposed_dispatch.fallback: Q4G64V0 for any attention/GDN projection whose Q8 integration fails resource or correctness checks; no second full projection view
proposed_dispatch.integration_status: Q8 attention/GDN family selection and grouped prefill consumer require TASK-021/022 implementation and testing

rejected_candidate_contracts.NVFP4: Rejected GGUF component probe: E2M1 nearest-even with saturation; per-row/per-16-K UE4M3 scale code = pinned gguf fp32_to_ue4m3(max(abs(block))/6), clamped to nonzero code for nonzero block; pinned encoder uses FP32 mantissa guard-bit increment (not ties-even), subnormal floor(x*512+0.5) clipped to 0..7, exponent >=15 maps to code 0x7e; decoded scale = 2*gguf ue4m3_to_fp32(code) with tensor scale 1. Zero block emits zero; reject nonfinite. Distinct from TASK-019 native-format nearest-even UE4M3 reference. CUTLASS reference pads N and K to 128; native MMA requires packed FP4 activations
